info.title: Labelburg
info.description:
Everything the label designer does is available through this API. The label designer itself sends the same requests.

Requests that print, save or delete labels are refused when a browser sends them from another website. Scripts and tools like `curl` are not affected. Requests for other host names than those of the home network (see Host names in the README) and of `HOSTS`, also in `Origin`, are refused with status 403; with `TRUSTED_HOSTS` set, those for other names than its own.

Errors are returned with status 400 (or 404, 413, 500) and a JSON object with `message`.

post.summary: Generate the label image without printing
post.description: The label as it is printed: the quality the request leaves out is taken from the printer settings (`/labeldesigner/api/settings`) of its printer. A label size left out is that of the tape the printer reports, else the one set in its printer settings, else `LABEL_DEFAULT_SIZE`. A label size the request names is shown as it is, not placed on the tape loaded in the printer. On a roll of several labels to a page, the preview is its first page as the label is seen upright: the label first, top left, followed by as many of the `print_count` copies as fit, each with its counter, the rest of the page blank.

parameters.name: return_format
parameters.description: `png` returns the image, `base64` the image as base64 text.

mark_blanks.description: 1 shows blanks without a value in the text as their name and a question mark, e.g. `Room?`, as the label designer previews them. A code that takes the text gets it without them.

print_count.description: Number of labels to be printed, for `X-Label-Sheet`.

labels_per_copy.description: Number of labels each copy prints, e.g. of several files or the pages of PDFs, for `X-Label-Sheet`. Left out, the pages `pdf_pages` selects of the file sent, else 1.

mark_blanks.description: 1 shows blanks without a value in the text as their name and a question mark, e.g. `Room?`, as the label designer previews them. A code that takes the text gets it without them.

print_count.description: Number of labels to be printed, for `X-Label-Sheet`.

labels_per_copy.description: Number of labels each copy prints, e.g. of several files or the pages of PDFs, for `X-Label-Sheet`. Left out, the pages `pdf_pages` selects of the file sent, else 1.

200.description: The label as it is printed.

X-Label-Warning.description: Set when text, a code or an image does not fit on the label and is cut off, when a font is not installed and the default font is used instead, when a fitted RMQR or PDF417 code makes the label longer than 200 mm, or when the printer (`printer`, `model`, else the configured one) refuses a label this long.

X-Label-Sheet.description: On a roll of several labels to a page, how `print_count` copies of `labels_per_copy` labels fill the last page, as JSON: `size` of the page and its `labels` as `[x, y, width, height]` in mm as the label is seen upright, in the order they are filled, how many of them are `filled`, and the `print_count` that would `fill` the page, null where it is full or that would be more than `PRINT_MAX_COUNT` labels. Not set for other label sizes.

X-PDF-Pages.description: Number of pages of an uploaded PDF.

X-PDF-Selected-Pages.description: Number of the pages of an uploaded PDF `pdf_pages` selects, each printed as a label of its own.

X-Image-Faint.description: `1` when the image of a label on a tape of the VC-500W is light all over, like a drawing in light washes, and would print better with `image_contrast`. Not set with `image_contrast` on.

X-Label-Orientation.description: `auto` when the orientation was chosen to show an image largest, which `image_fit` does for an image without text on a die-cut label. `orientation` has no effect then.

X-Label-Image-Text-Gap.description: Distance between the image or code and the text in dots, for labels with both. The given `image_text_gap` or the one chosen without it.

X-Label-Image-Position.description: Where the image or code is next to the text, for labels with both: `above`, `below`, `left` or `right`, as given in `image_position`, as `parts_order` places it or chosen without them.

X-Label-Parts-Order.description: The parts of a label with at least two of them as laid out, e.g. `image,code,text`: as given in `parts_order`, else as at `image_position` or chosen without it. Left out for a label of one part.

X-Label-Parts-Direction.description: How the parts in `X-Label-Parts-Order` follow each other: `row` or `column`.

X-Label-Colors.description: The colors asked for that the tape prints otherwise, as JSON, each with the color printed, e.g. `{"#2563eb": "black"}` on a tape without red. Left out where all print as asked.

X-Label-Parts.description: Where the lines, the code and the image are on the label, as JSON in pixels of the preview: `[{"part": "line", "index": 0, "box": [x0, y0, x1, y1]}, {"part": "code", "box": [...]}, {"part": "image", "box": [...]}]`. `index` is that of the line in `text`, a line that wraps has one box. A cable flag has each part twice. Left out for a label with many lines.

400.description: Invalid parameters, e.g. "Font size is required".

413.description: The request or the text is too large.

get.description: The settings made in the printer settings of the label designer, kept on the server for every browser: the label size set by hand, the cutting, which end of the labels leaves first and how it finds its labels of the printer, the quality of all printers. A setting not made is left out.

Each is checked as for printing, e.g. a label size the printer cannot take is refused. The answer also tells the tape in the printer after the change, from the last answer of the printer without asking it.

They are listed by `printer_status` after the configured or detected ones, with `added`, and requests may name them by their address or name. While `ADD_PRINTERS` is `off` they are not used.

post.summary: Ask what answers at an address
post.description: Asks the device at an address what it is, without adding it: a printer shared over USB/IP for its IEEE 1284 device ID, a network printer over SNMP and IPP. Nothing is sent to the port a printer takes jobs on before it is known as a printer of a model this server prints on; then its status is read, e.g. the tape in it. Where the address may be is set by `ADD_PRINTERS` of the server: `local` (the default) only in the local network (loopback, 10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16, 100.64/10, fc00::/7), `any` also elsewhere, `off` not at all. Every address a host name resolves to must be allowed, link-local, multicast, broadcast and reserved ones never are.

200.description: What answers.

400.description: Not added: the mode does not allow the address, nothing answers or it is no printer this server knows, `message` says why in plain words.

post.description: Adds the printer at an address, asked what it is first as by `printers/identify`. It is kept with the printer settings in the folder of the labels. A network printer is kept by the address its model takes, e.g. `vc500w://` for a VC-500W given as `tcp://`. Where the address may be is set by `ADD_PRINTERS` of the server: `local` (the default) only in the local network (loopback, 10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16, 100.64/10, fc00::/7), `any` also elsewhere, `off` not at all. Every address a host name resolves to must be allowed, link-local, multicast, broadcast and reserved ones never are.

post.description: The label is cut as saved with it (`cut`, `half_cut`, `chain`), unless the request names `cut` or `cut_once`: then the request decides all three. What the request leaves out is taken from the printer settings (`/labeldesigner/api/settings`): the quality and which end leaves first, and the cutting where the label has none of its own. A label without a label size of its own is made for the tape the printer reports, else the one set in its printer settings, else `LABEL_DEFAULT_SIZE`. A label made for another tape is placed on the tape loaded in the printer, or on the one set by hand where the printer reports none.

parameters.name: id

leaves_first.description: The end of the labels that leaves the printer first, `top` or `bottom`, e.g. to stick them on as they come out. Set for each printer in the printer settings (`/labeldesigner/api/settings`), never saved with a label. Default: as set there, else as the driver prints them.

printer.description: Printer to use: the configured one, the name of one listed in `PRINTERS`, `simulation`, `file:///dev/usb/lp<N>`, `usb://<vendor>:<product>` or `tcp://<host>`. Default: `PRINTER_PRINTER`. A network printer that is neither configured, added in the Settings nor found by the search only at an address `ADD_PRINTERS` allows, see `printers/identify`.

model.description: Printer model, e.g. `QL-800`, other makers than Brother with the maker, e.g. `PUQU/Q00`. Default: `PRINTER_MODEL`.

print_count.description: Number of labels, at most `PRINT_MAX_COUNT` (default 100). `{{counter}}` counts up from label to label. On a roll of several labels to a page they fill the pages one after the other.

cut_once.description: 1 cuts only after the last label, like `cut` `last`.

Homebox replaces the query of the address, so a saved label is named in the path. The label is made for the printer the label designer starts with, at the resolution of the quality set for it; the sizes in pixels that Homebox sends are not used. Nothing is printed.

parameters.description: Name of the saved label, with or without `.json`, e.g. `Homebox`.

400.description: No image, or the printer cannot print the label, `message` says why.

200.description: OpenAPI description.

QueuedAnswer.description: The answer to a print request: the job is accepted. `success` does not tell that it printed, read that from `/labeldesigner/api/queue/{job_id}`.

job.description: The id of the job, for `/labeldesigner/api/queue/{job_id}`.

state.description: Where the job is when the request is answered. One that prints at once, e.g. on the demo printer, may have ended already.

image.description: The image of the first label as base64 PNG, with `return_format=png`.

title.description: What the job prints, as the queue shows it.

from.description: Where the job came from in plain words: `another program` (the API or the webhook), `an AI assistant` (MCP) or `Homebox`. Empty for the label designer.

from_detail.description: How the job was sent, e.g. `Sent over the API`, `Sent over the webhook` or `Sent over MCP`, which the label designer shows as a hover text. Empty where `from` says it all.

message.description: Why a job failed, or that it was removed. Empty otherwise.

preview.description: The URL of its preview, `null` without one.

progress.description: The `job` of the printer as `/labeldesigner/api/printer_status` tells it, only for the job that prints in a line read by `printer`.

start.description: Only when a single job is read.

held.description: Why the line waits: the message of the job that did not print. `null` if it does not.

printer.description: The device the last job of the line was added under, `simulation` for the demo printer.

image.description: The image of the first label printed as base64 PNG, with `return_format=png`.

Calibration.description: How the labels of a printer are moved to sit straight on its roll, in millimeters: right and down positive.

across.description: Moved right, in steps of 0.25 from -5 to 5.

along.description: Moved down, toward the end that leaves the printer last, in steps of 0.25 from -5 to 5.

roll.description: The serial number of the roll it was made on, from its RFID tag.

label_size.description: The label size set by hand, used where the printer does not report its media.

demo_model.description: Of the demo printer (`simulation`) only: the model it prints as, one the drivers know, e.g. `VC-500W` or `Niimbot/B1`. Choosing one sets `label_size` too: the one set if the model takes it, else the one it is assumed to have. Empty: its configured model.

leaves_first.description: The end of the labels that leaves the printer first, else as the driver prints them.

sensing.description: How the printer finds the start of each label: by the gaps between them, by black marks on their back, or not at all on a continuous roll. Only of ZPL printers, the others find their labels by themselves and refuse it. Not set, the printer finds them as it is set up.

printer.description: The device or name of the printer, the configured one if left out.

date_format.description: How dates are written: of date blanks without a format of their own, and of dates the label designer puts on labels. Empty: as the browser writes dates, `%Y-%m-%d` for date blanks of API requests.

collate.description: Order of the copies of several files or PDF pages where the request and the saved label leave it out: 1 as sets (ABC ABC), 0 grouped (AA BB CC). Empty: as sets.

font_family.description: A font family of the server or of the label designer's font menu, e.g. `DejaVu Sans` or `DejaVu Sans Mono`: new labels of the label designer start with it, lines of a request without a font are printed in its regular style. Empty: the configured default font.

TextLine.description: One line of text. Templates like `{{datetime:%d.%m.%Y}}` (or a date moved from today, e.g., `{{datetime+5d:%d.%m.%Y}}` 5 days later: `d` days, `w` weeks, `m` months, `y` years, `h` hours, `min` minutes, at most a hundred years), `{{counter}}` (or `{{counter:<start>:<step>}}`: the first label gets `<start>`, written as the values should look, e.g., `001` for 001, 002, ... or `A` for A, B, ..., Z, AA, and each next one `<step>` more), `{{asn}}` (or `{{asn:<digits>}}`: the next archive serial number for Paperless-ngx, counted on for each label, see `PAPERLESS_URL`), `{{uuid}}`, `{{short-uuid}}`, `{{env:<var>}}`, `{{random}}`, `{{mdi:<name>}}` (a Material Design Icon, e.g., `{{mdi:printer}}`), `{{fastener:<name>}}` and `{{electronic:<name>}}` (a fastener or an electronic component, e.g., `{{fastener:head-torx}}`, the names in `/static/symbols/symbols.json`) are filled in when the label is generated.

text.description: A line break, also in the value of a blank, starts another line with the same settings.

font.description: Font as `<family>,<style>`, e.g. `DejaVu Sans,Book`. Default: the font of new labels in its regular style, as set in the label settings (`/labeldesigner/api/settings/labels`), else the configured default font, which also replaces fonts that are not installed.

size.description: Font size in dots (300 dpi), e.g. `70`.

checkbox.description: A checkbox in front of the line (to-do item).

underline.description: The text of the line underlined, in the color of the line.

color.description: Color of the line. `black`, `red` or any color as `#rrggbb`. It is limited to what the label shows: any color on the tapes of the VC-500W, black or red on black/red/white labels (red for reddish colors), black on all others.

Label.description: Parameters of a label. All are optional, the defaults are those of the label designer.

label_size.description: Label size identifier, e.g. `62`, `62x29`, `103x164`, `d24`, or a tape of the VC-500W (`vc9`, `vc12`, `vc19`, `vc25`, `vc50`). The label designer lists them.

label_length.description: Length of an endless label as cut, in millimeters, with the margin the printer feeds before and after the print: 3 mm each on QL printers, 2 mm on TZe tape, 1 mm on that of the PT-P900 series. The content is laid out in it as on a die-cut label. At least 12.7 mm (TZe tape: 4.4 mm) and these margins, at most the longest label a printer of the tape prints, e.g., 3000 mm on 62 mm tape (QL-1100), which a QL-800 refuses to print beyond 1000 mm. Empty or left out, the label is as long as its content. Die-cut labels have their own length and do not use it, neither do cable flags and the tapes of the VC-500W and of receipt printers, whose labels are as long as their content.

high_res.description: 600 dpi printing along the label. Labels usually come out much darker, it is only confirmed for the QL-800. The QL-1100 series and the P-touch printers cannot print at 600 dpi and refuse it.

fast_printing.description: 1 prints faster: the printer does not give priority to print quality, the print is a little less sharp. A QL-810W printed a 29 x 90 mm label in 1.8 instead of 3.0 s. The VC-500W prints in its color instead of its vivid mode, colors come out lighter, a 25 mm label took 27 instead of 33 s.

shrink_text.description: Make all lines of text smaller by the same factor until they fit on the label, instead of cutting the text off. Like `text_fit` `shrink`, which takes its place where given.

text_fit.description: How the text is sized: `none` as set, `shrink` all lines smaller by the same factor where it does not fit, `fill` all lines by the same factor as large as fits within the margins: as wide as endless tape, as high as tape it runs along, both ways on die-cut labels. Left out, `shrink_text` decides between `shrink` and `none`.

text_wrap.description: 1 wraps lines wider than the room for the text at spaces into several lines with the same settings, before `text_fit` shrinks or fills the text. A word longer than a line is broken only where the text keeps its size. Lines do not wrap along endless tape (`orientation` `rotated`), which grows with them, nor filled on endless tape, where each line fills the width of the tape.

mirror.description: 1 prints the label mirror-inverted, left and right swapped as the text reads, e.g., on clear tape stuck on the inside of a window to be read through the glass. The preview shows it mirrored as well.

image_text_gap.description: Distance between the image or code and the text in dots, for labels with both, with `image_qrcode_text` on both sides of the text (between image and code without text). Empty or left out chooses two fifths of the largest text size, for a 2D code at least two of its modules.

image_position.description: Where the image or code is next to the text, for labels with both. Left out or empty: above it across the tape, left of it along the tape (`orientation` `rotated`). With `image_qrcode_text` the image is there, left of the text if left out, and the code on the other side. An endless label grows along the tape to hold both. Fitted to the label (`image_fit`), it takes at most half of the label along the side of the text, the text the rest, where the label does not grow with the text, with `image_qrcode_text` the image and the code a third each. Where it is follows the lines of text as written, also those of blanks left empty.

parts_order.description: The image, the code and the text in any order, one after the other in `parts_direction`, e.g. `image,code,text` for the text right of a code that is right of the image. Each part named once, spaces around the names are left out; parts the label does not have are skipped, parts it has that are left out follow in the order of `image_position`. The text is in the middle of the room left between its neighbors. Fitted (`image_fit`), the image and the code take a part of the side along the direction as next to `image_position`. A label of two parts in an order is laid out as at the matching `image_position`. Left out or empty: as at `image_position`, which it overrides.

parts_direction.description: How the parts of `parts_order` follow each other: `row` side by side as the text reads, also along the tape, `column` one below the other. Left out or empty: as at `image_position`, left and right a row, above and below a column.

vertical_align.description: Where the content (text, code or image) is between the top and bottom margins of a label that has room to spare: die-cut labels, endless tape with `orientation` `rotated`, across the tape, and endless labels of a `label_length`. Top and bottom are as the text reads. An endless label across the tape without a `label_length` grows with its content and has its content in the middle. Left out or empty: `center`.

print_type.description: `qrcode` prints a code, `qrcode_text` a code with text, `image` an uploaded image or PDF (with optional text), `image_qrcode_text` an image and a code with the text between them (see `image_position`), refused without an image.

text.description: The lines of text as JSON array of `TextLine` objects.

code_text.description: Content of the code, its templates are filled in like those of the text. Without it, or with only blanks that are left empty, the code contains the text of all lines.

barcode_type.description: One of `/labeldesigner/api/barcodes`. The 2D codes DATAMATRIX, MICROQR, RMQR, AZTEC and PDF417 are made like QR codes: of dots of the size `qrcode_size`, of the text of all lines where `code_text` is left out. DataMatrix codes hold ASCII characters only. Of a code with a check digit, e.g., EAN13, ISBN10 or UPCA, give the digits without it, which calculates it, or with the right one. A wrong one is refused.

qrcode_size.description: Size of a dot of a 2D code in dots of the label. The rows of a PDF417 code are three times as high.

qrcode_correction.description: Error correction of QR (L, M, Q or H), Micro QR (L, M or Q) and rMQR codes (M or H). Left out or empty: the lowest the code has. Another level is refused, other codes ignore it.

image.description: Image or PDF for `print_type=image` and `image_qrcode_text`, as file upload. Printing takes several (the field repeated), each printed as a label of its own, of a PDF the pages `pdf_pages` selects. The preview uses the first.

image_mode.description: Another one is refused. `bw` is read as `black_and_white`. On the tapes of the VC-500W images stay in color.

image_bw_threshold.description: Brightness below which pixels print black in `black_and_white` mode.

image_fit.description: Fit the image to the label, on endless tape across it, with `image_qrcode_text` the code as well. On die-cut labels an image without text or code is also turned to the orientation that shows it largest. Next to text see `image_position`.

image_crop.description: Crop the image to its content.

image_contrast.description: 1 prints the image with stronger contrast and colors on the tapes of the VC-500W, for drawings in light washes, which print faint otherwise. White and black stay. Photos look better without it. Other tapes ignore it. The preview shows it.

image_scaling_factor.description: Scale in percent, only without `image_fit`. With `image_qrcode_text` of the image only, like `image_crop` and `image_rotation`: the code keeps its size.

pdf_pages.description: Pages of a PDF to print, each as a label of its own, e.g. `1-3, 5`, `4-` or `all`. Default: the first page. Copies print the selection several times. The preview shows the first selected page.

margin_top.description: Margins in dots, at 300 dpi about 12 dots are 1 mm.

border_thickness.description: Border in dots, 0 prints no border.

border_roundness.description: Corner radius of the border in dots.

cable_flag.description: Print a cable flag: the label twice, with room between them to wrap around the cable, so that both ends stick together back to back. With the text across the tape the second label is upside down. Continuous tape only.

cable_diameter.description: Diameter of the cable in mm for `cable_flag`, from 1 to 50, e.g. `6.5`. Empty for 6.5 mm, a Cat.7 patch cable.

border_color.description: Color of the border. `black`, `red` or any color as `#rrggbb`. It is limited to what the label shows: any color on the tapes of the VC-500W, black or red on black/red/white labels (red for reddish colors), black on all others.

print_color.description: Color of codes. `black`, `red` or any color as `#rrggbb`. It is limited to what the label shows: any color on the tapes of the VC-500W, black or red on black/red/white labels (red for reddish colors), black on all others.

name.description: Name to save the label under.

tags.description: Tags the label designer groups saved labels by, a list or texts with commas between them, at most 20 of at most 40 characters each. They are trimmed and split at commas, and each is kept once whatever its case. A label saved again without `tags` keeps those it had, an empty list removes them.

title.description: Name of the label as the label designer saved it, missing for labels saved without one.

tags.description: Tags of the label, empty for none.

label_size_id.description: Identifier of the label size, as `label_size` of a print request.

Tape.description: The tape in the printer: the one it reports, else the label size set by hand in its settings, else an assumed one. A tape the model cannot print counts as none, e.g., one set by hand for another printer at the same address. One set by hand for the same paper of another model is the model's size of it, e.g. `escpos80-180` for `escpos80` on a 180 dpi receipt printer. Of a printer that measures only the length of its labels, e.g. a ZPL printer, one set by hand counts only if it has that length; with none set by hand, the only label size of that length is the one it reports.

known.description: The tape is reported or set by hand.

assumed.description: The printer reports none that matches, `id` is a guess.

unknown.description: What the printer reports where no label size matches, e.g. `40 mm`, or the length it measured where it tells no width and none of that length is set by hand, e.g. `50 mm long`.

red_unknown.description: The printer cannot tell whether the roll is a black and red one.

candidates.description: Label sizes of the length the printer measured where it tells no width, else empty.

fits.description: Label sizes printed as they are on this tape.

moves.description: Label sizes that are put on this tape. Where it is not known, those of the same paper of another model, which are put on the printer's size of it.

place.description: Where a label goes on this tape, by `<label size>|<orientation>`. An orientation other than `rotated` is `standard`.

path.description: Printer to pass as `printer`, e.g. `file:///dev/usb/lp0` or `simulation`.

name.description: Name of a printer listed in `PRINTERS` or added in the Settings, empty if it has none. Missing for other printers. Requests may pass it as `printer`.

added.description: A printer added in the Settings, see `printers/added`. Missing for others.

model.description: Model reported by the printer, `Unknown` if it has not answered yet. Other makers than Brother with the maker, e.g. `PUQU/Q00`.

device_name.description: Maker and model a printer on USB names in its device ID, e.g. `Xprinter XP-58IIH` for an `Epson/ESC-POS` or `Zebra GX420t` for a `Zebra/ZPL`, where its model is one for printers of many makers. The label designer shows it instead of the model. Missing where the printer names none.

errors.description: Errors reported by the printer, or why it does not answer.

media_width.description: Width of the loaded roll in mm.

media_length.description: Length of die-cut labels in mm, 0 for endless rolls.

red_roll.description: Whether the loaded roll is a black and red one, as the QL-800 series reports it. `null` where the printer does not tell.

color_support.description: The printer prints in color (VC-500W), the label designer then offers any color.

label_size.description: Label size of the tape labels are placed on, as `label_size` takes it: the one the printer reports, else the one set in its printer settings, each only where the printer prints on it, else the assumed one: `LABEL_DEFAULT_SIZE`, else the first one the printer takes.

label_size_assumed.description: `label_size` is assumed: the printer reports no tape it takes and none it takes is set in its printer settings.

takes.description: Label sizes the printer takes, every size that has printers for a model no label size names.

tape_length_mm.description: VC-500W: length of the tape in the cassette when new, in millimeters.

tape_remaining_mm.description: VC-500W: tape left in the cassette, in millimeters.

weak_connection.description: VC-500W on Wi-Fi: some of the last 20 status questions of the server got no answer, moving the printer closer to the Wi-Fi router may help.

battery_low.description: Niimbot: the battery of the printer needs charging, it is at 1 of 4 or less.

battery.description: Niimbot: the charge of the battery in percent, in steps of 25, as the printer tells it in 4 steps.

serial.description: Niimbot B1: the serial number of the printer, its settings and calibration follow it on any connection.

roll.description: Niimbot: the serial number of the roll in the printer, from its RFID tag, null without one.

calibration.description: Of a printer that offers calibration (the Niimbot B1): how its labels are moved, see /api/calibration.

queue.description: The line of print jobs of the printer, see `/labeldesigner/api/queue`.

held.description: A job did not print, the jobs behind it wait for `/labeldesigner/api/queue/continue`.

job.description: The job the printer prints for this server, also what a VC-500W does while it prints a label, which takes about 40 s.

stage.description: e.g. `Preparing`, `Preheating`, `Printing`, `Ejecting` or `Take the printed label out of the printer`.

percent.description: While printing: how far the label is, estimated.

label.description: The label printed, counted from 1, on printers that tell each label printed.

labels.description: The labels of the job, its pages where `unit` is `page`.

unit.description: `page` where the printer prints pages of several labels, e.g. a Niimbot B1 on such a roll: `label` and `labels` count pages. Left out otherwise.

seconds_left.description: About how long the job still takes: estimated from the print speed of the model, corrected by how long earlier jobs of the printer took and by the labels it printed.

address.description: The address of the printer, as for `PRINTERS`: `usbip://<host>[:<port>][/<bus ID>]`, `tcp://<host>`, `vc500w://<host>`, `usb://<vendor>:<product>[/<serial number>]` or `file:///dev/usb/lp<N>`. A host alone is taken as `tcp://<host>`.

The address of the printer, as for `PRINTERS`: `usbip://<host>[:<port>][/<bus ID>]`, `tcp://<host>`, `vc500w://<host>`, `usb://<vendor>:<product>[/<serial number>]` or `file:///dev/usb/lp<N>`. A host alone is taken as `tcp://<host>`.

name.description: Shown in the label designer, requests may choose the printer by it. Letters and digits, also spaces, dots, hyphens and underscores between them, at most 40 characters, not the name of another printer. Empty for none.

printer.description: The address or name of the added printer.

address.description: Pass it, or the name, as `printer`.
The address it would be added with.

device_id.description: Fields of its IEEE 1284 device ID: `MFG`, `MDL`, `CMD`, `CLS` and `DES` where it tells them.

errors.description: What its status reports, or why it did not answer it.

listed.description: The name, else the address, it is listed with already, `null` if it is not.

selected.description: Printer used when a request names none.

hints.description: What the search for printers (`PRINTER_PRINTER` `?`) could not do, e.g. "Printers on usb:// need libusb, please install it", or left alone, e.g. a printer the computer shares over USB/IP.

label_size.description: Default: that of the tape the printer reports, else the one set in its printer settings, else `LABEL_DEFAULT_SIZE`.

image_mode.description: Another one is refused. `bw` is read as `black_and_white`.

leaves_first.description: The end of the labels that leaves the printer first, `top` or `bottom`, e.g. to stick them on as they come out. Set for each printer in the printer settings (`/labeldesigner/api/settings`), never saved with a label. Default: as set there, else as the driver prints them.

image_contrast.description: Stronger contrast for the images on the tapes of the VC-500W, see the label field of the same name.

printer.description: Printer to use: the configured one, the name of one listed in `PRINTERS`, `simulation`, `file:///dev/usb/lp<N>`, `usb://<vendor>:<product>` or `tcp://<host>`. Default: `PRINTER_PRINTER`. A network printer that is neither configured, added in the Settings nor found by the search only at an address `ADD_PRINTERS` allows, see `printers/identify`.

model.description: Printer model, e.g. `QL-800`, other makers than Brother with the maker, e.g. `PUQU/Q00`. Default: `PRINTER_MODEL`.

BlankValues.description: Values for the blanks (`{{blank:<name>}}`) in the text and the code as JSON object of texts or numbers, e.g., `{"Room": "Garage"}`. They are inserted as given, numbers as they are written, also an empty text. Blanks not given get their default from `fields`, dates today's date in the time zone of the server (environment variable `TZ`), others stay empty. A date like 2026-11-03, or one moved from today like `+5d` (`d` days, `w` weeks, `m` months, `y` years), is written in the format from `fields`, else as it is. A blank is a date if `fields` says so, else text. A blank of the type `choice` takes one of its choices, another value is refused.

BlankSettings.description: Settings of the blanks by name as JSON object, as the label designer saves them with a label: `type` (`text`, `number`, `date` or `choice`), `default` (for a date also one moved from today, e.g., `+5d`), for a date its `format` (strftime, e.g., `%d.%m.%Y`, without one as set in the label settings, else `%Y-%m-%d`), and for a choice its `choices` (1 to 50 texts of at most 200 characters, none twice; the default is one of them, else the first one). Another type, a format that is no text, a default that is no text or number, a date moved by another offset, or choices that are no such list are refused.

SavedLabelBlanks.description: Values for the blanks (`{{blank:<name>}}`) of the label as JSON object of texts or numbers, e.g., `{"Room": "Garage"}`. They are inserted as given, numbers as they are written, also an empty text. Blanks not given get their default saved with the label, dates today's date in the time zone of the server (environment variable `TZ`), others stay empty. A date like 2026-11-03, or one moved from today like `+5d` (`d` days, `w` weeks, `m` months, `y` years), is written in the format saved with the label, else as it is. A blank is a date if its saved type says so, else text. A blank of the type `choice` takes one of its choices, another value is refused. A blank not given here takes a field of the request named like it, e.g., `product` as Grocy sends it; a name with dots one inside an object, e.g., `stock_entry.best_before_date` (in a form `stock_entry[best_before_date]`). The parameters of the request, e.g., `name` or `printer`, are never taken for blanks.

Cutting.description: How the labels of a job are cut. Saved with a label, it is cut so wherever it is printed; an empty cut follows the setting of the printer in the label designer.

cut.description: Cut after each label, after the last one or not at all. Without it `cut_once` decides. The VC-500W refuses `none`, it would keep the labels until the next print.

half_cut.description: P-touch printers and the VC-500W: half cut between labels that are not cut, the backing stays whole. Without it the VC-500W does not cut between them.

chain.description: P-touch printers: chain printing, the last label stays in the printer and the next print cuts it off, without feeding tape before it. Always on with cut none, else the printer cuts after the last label.
